newsitem.title: ROMANIA: France's Depardieu eyes investments in Romania.
newsitem.headline: France's Depardieu eyes investments in Romania.

text.p: French actor Gerard Depardieu, in Romania for a 24-hour visit, said on Wednesday he was considering investing in enterprises ranging from wine to the theatre in the former comunist country.
"I am going to invest in the theatre, communications and the food and textile industry," Depardieu, 48, told reporters after meeting Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
Depardieu's trip included a meeting with reformist President Emil Constantinescu, whose centrist coalition ousted leftists in last November's polls and is seeking foreign investment.
"I came to see a bit of the country, talk to some ministers and see what can be done for culture as well as in business," said Depardieu.
He came here with his Romanian-born friend, former tennis star Ilie Nastase, who lost last year's race to become mayor of Bucharest to Ciorbea.
"Romania is a beautiful country and its women are even more beautiful," Depardieu said.
